text.body: śrī lakṣmī stuti śrī viṣṇu purāṇa meṃ kathita indra dvārā kṛta namastasyai sarvabhūtānāṃ jananīmabjasambhavām śriyamunindrapadmākṣīṃ viṣṇuvakṣaḥsthalasthitām|| padmālayāṃ padmakarāṃ padmapatranibhekṣaṇām vande padmamukhīṃ devīṃ padmanābhapriyāmyaham|| tvaṃ siddhistvaṃ svadhā svāhā sudhā tvaṃ lokapāvanī sandhayā rātriḥ prabhā bhūtirmedhā śraddhā sarasvatī|| yajñavidyā mahāvidyā guhyavidyā ca śobhane ātmavidyā ca devi tvaṃ vimuktiphaladāyinī|| ānvīkṣikī trayīvārtā daṇḍanītistvameva ca saumyāsaumyerjagadrūpaistvayaitaddevi pūritam|| kā tvanyā tvamṛte devi sarvayajñamayaṃ vapuḥ adhyāste devadevasya yogicintyaṃ gadābhṛtaḥ|| tvayā devi parityaktaṃ sakalaṃ bhuvanatrayam vinaṣṭaprāyamabhavattvayedānīṃ samedhitam|| dārāḥ putrāstathā''gāraṃ suhṛddhānyadhanādikam bhavatyetanmahābhāge nityaṃ tvadvīkṣaṇānnṛṇām|| śarīrārogyamaiśvaryamaripakṣakṣayaḥ sukham devi tvadṛṣṭidṛṣṭānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ na durlabham|| tvamambā sarvabhūtānāṃ devadevo hariḥ pitā tvayaitadviṣṇunā cāmba jagadvayāptaṃ carācaram|| manaḥkośastathā goṣṭhaṃ mā gṛhaṃ mā paricchadam mā śarīraṃ kalatraṃ ca tyajethāḥ sarvapāvani|| mā putrānmā suhṛdvargānmā paśūnmā vibhūṣaṇam tyajethā mama devasya viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalāśraye|| sattvena satyaśaucābhyāṃ tathā śīlādibhirguṇaiḥ tyajyante te narāḥ sadyaḥ santyaktā ye tvayā'male|| tvayā'valokitāḥ sadyaḥ śīlādyairakhilairguṇaiḥ kulaiśvaryaiśca yujyante puruṣā nirguṇā api|| saślāghyaḥ saguṇī dhanyaḥ sa kulīnaḥ sa buddhimān sa śūraḥ sacavikrānto yastvayā devi vīkṣitaḥ|| sadyovaiguṇyamāyānti śīlādyāḥ sakalā guṇāḥ parāṅgamukhī jagaddhātrī yasya tvaṃ viṣṇuvallabhe|| na te varṇayituṃ śaktāguṇañjihvā'pi vedhasaḥ prasīda devi padmākṣi mā'smāṃstyākṣīḥ kadācana|| śrīparāśara bole evaṃ śrīḥ saṃstutā smayak prāha hṛṣṭā śatakratum śrṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ sarvabhūtasthitā dvija|| śrī bolīṃ parituṣṭāsmi deveśa stotreṇānena te hareḥ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva yastviṣṭo varadā'haṃ tavāgatā|| indra bole varadā yadimedevi varārho yadivā'pyaham trailokyaṃ na tvayā tyācyameṣa me'stu varaḥ paraḥ|| stotreṇa yastavaitena tvāṃ stoṣyatyabdhisambhave sa tvayā na parityājyo dvitīyo'stuvaro mama|| śrī bolīṃ trailokyaṃ tridaśaśreṣṭha na santyakṣyāmi vāsava datto varo mayā'yaṃ te stotrārādhanatuṣṭayā|| yaśca sāyaṃ tathā prātaḥ stotreṇānena mānavaḥ stoṣyate cenna tasyāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi parāṅgamukhī||
